title: The Crossing, Town Green Southwest

source.description: The hedgerow to the west meets the row of tall lunat trees that separates the Town Green from the commercial traffic on Lunat Shade Road due south. The growth is especially dense here, with no way to slip past either of the living fences. The small thorns on the hedges, to keep out stray livestock in search of prime pasture, look daunting in any case.
